description:
The findings reports of three closed benchmark surveys restate figures that live in generated tables, receipts and acceptance summaries; those hand-maintained copies go stale when the evidence or its projection changes.

## Background

The project invariant single-source-prose requires every fact with a single source of truth to reach prose by projection or citation; a hand-maintained copy is a staleness defect. The reports `dev/active/c077a88b/findings.md` (compatible LDPC decoder arms), `dev/active/1d0da41f/findings.md` (YMM carry-less multiplication repair) and `dev/active/eda07788/findings.md` (shift and coding-permutation baselines) copy speedups, intervals, per-call times, ratios and resolution figures from their generated tables and receipts into prose and hand-typed tables.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The three reports restate no number held by a generated table, receipt, acceptance summary, ledger or other committed artifact; each quantitative statement is a conclusion with a pointer to its authoritative location.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every results table the reports rely on is written by a committed generator from committed evidence, and regenerating it from a clean checkout reproduces the committed file byte for byte.
- [hard] REQ-03: No receipt, ledger, addendum or other measurement evidence changes, and every conclusion the reports stated before the change remains stated or is corrected with the correction recorded.

## Notes

Documentation and generator work only; no production code or measurement changes.
title: Replace hand-copied numbers in closed survey reports with citations
